title: Unique Hearty Venezuelan Beef Stew
description: A rich and flavorful stew featuring cinnamon stick and a blend of herbs, perfect for a cold evening or as a hangover cure. This macrobiotic-friendly dish is made with wholesome ingredients and is slow-cooked to perfection.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the beef cubes and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the cinnamon stick, oregano, and cumin, and cook for 1 minute.
Add the beef broth, red wine, and potatoes, and bring to a boil.
Cover the pot and transfer to the oven, where it will braise at 300 degrees for 2 1/2 hours.
Remove the pot from the oven and let it cool slightly before serving.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
